title: Velvac 704152-5 Door Blind Spot Mirror
amazon_match_notes: Verified exact match: ASIN B00460BXTM is the Velvac 704152-5 door blind spot mirror.

comparisons.notes: New Velvac 704152-5, 6.5 x 10 inches; product page lists one item and in-stock availability.
Manufacturer-direct SKU 704152-5, side mount, black plastic, sold each. Page says in stock, though its title says convex while its specifications say flat.

writeup: Woot has a new Velvac 704152-5 door blind spot mirror for $4.99. BuyParts.Online lists the matching 6.5 x 10 inch model new and in stock at $31.47. Velvac sells the same SKU 704152-5 side-mount black plastic mirror manufacturer-direct for $33.68 and reports it in stock. That is about 84 percent below BuyParts.Online and saves roughly $26. Woot showed 3+ left with a limit of three per customer.
